comment: Dr. Calvillo is very knowledgeable about art history. However she is somewhat unclear about grading standards, in addition to due dates. She is rather of a harsh grader, and the class is primarily just lecture. She is also behind on grading a lot. Overall, would not recommend if you are taking this class for a history gen-ed.

Dr. Calvillo is a brilliant art historian and truly cares about her students. However, her expectations are not very clear - you won't know your grade until it's on your transcript, and she is a very hard grader. Exams are straightforward, just lots of memorization and analysis, but she always hosts review sessions. You have to work HARD for an A.

This class is heavy on lecture. Slides are sometimes messy and disorganized. She is kind, but she it nitpicky on grading. Is disorganized with due dates and responding to emails sometimes. Does not give feedback on on some assignments when she said she would.

I mean, Professor Calvillo is LITERALLY the queen of all queens. I can't imagine why on earth someone would write anything negative about her. She is EXTREMELY knowledgeable and truly knows everything about everything. You could ask her any art history-related question, and she would know. Richmond is lucky to have her. I took 229 (not listed here)

Dr. Calvillo is an amazing prof. & a remarkable art historian. She keeps class interesting & modernizes her lectures to keep them up to date & relevant to her students. She really cares about her students & their progress & development inside & outside her class. She also makes her self accesible which is very nice considering how busy she is.10/10

Dr. Calvillo is the best. She is an absolute boss of art history. Anyone who says otherwise doesn't know what they are talking about. She made the class fun and welcoming and was very understanding. She was very interactive and made sure we got the best overview of Renaissance art. She also gave great critique and feedback that has helped me grow.

She is your below-average professor. I felt like we were given a lot of unnecessary information in her class. Also, her grading was not consistent. The same answers were marked wrong on on one and right on others. She provided little feedback on your assignments. No interest in interacting with students. Avoid this teacher! Sincerely

Professor Calvillo is not a friendly person. Her lectures are dry. She did not make an effort to make study Renssasice art interesting. Most importantly, she does not care about teaching. She would answer her phone calls in class SEVERAL times during the semester! Would not recommend her class!

She's the best. Pretty easy grader and will grade even easier if you show even the slightest bit of interest in the course. The tests require studying but she doesn't want to make it difficult. Definitely take any class with her.

She really cares about her students.  Even in a lecture style class she keeps it interesting with funny jokes or bits of information.  She is tough, but she is also very willing to help.  I highly recommend taking a class from her if you're willing to do the work, even if you are only the slightest bit interested in the subject.

Definitely knows her subject!  Very busy woman, so a bit difficult to get in touch with.  Although the class was reading-and-writing-intensive, she was always willing to help.  Challenging but fair, and genuinely cares about her students.  You might not want to take this class if you have no prior experience with art history.
such an amazing teacher, she really knows her stuff.  you'll be lucky if you get another teacher like her again.  i loved her class and would recommend it to anyone.

I took this class "just for fun," and although it turned out to be pretty challenging I really gained a lot from it. Prof. Calvillo is ridiculously smart. She also has a witty sense of humor that livens up the lectures. This class is totally worth it.
Hard. brilliant. interesting.  HARD>.
Brilliant professor and very supportive!

She is great! She made art really interesting and although we did have to read a lot - it was no more than for any other class.  She is very helpful and really wants to get to know her students - definatly recommend
She's very intelligent and you learn a lot in class.  There is a lot of reading; however, she's a very nice person who is always available to help you out.

She is a great lecturer, very engaging. No artsy fartsy b.s. I had little interest in this subject, but the class was pretty enjoyable. The workload is intense for a 300 level - LOTS of writing, LOTS of long period essays and articles to read. Exams are more laid back, overall it was a good class.
No Comments
Very boring class and she does not make learning about the Renaissance fun whatsoever.  There's a ton of reading and she's not a very friendly person
